notes: Integrating Essential Skills accounts for about 20% of operational enhanced ACT Math content.
These items emphasize synthesis, fluency, transfer, and nonroutine multi-step use of foundational mathematics rather than easier versions of Preparing for Higher Math items.
Every V2.1 ACT item remains four-choice multiple choice; Modeling is cross-cutting and may be tagged on appropriate Essential Skills items.
Native ACT skill ids are used instead of fabricating Texas alignments. Later curriculum crosswalks may connect them to legitimate prerequisite standards without changing the assessment bank.
All 12 Integrating Essential Skills skill areas are authored in the V2.1 draft bank.
